zh.headline: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，主打编程与计算机操作
zh.observation: 今天最密集的信号是**"前沿放缓"叙事的反噬**——Amodei 的倡议在 48 小时内从"安全共识"演变为被指"卡特尔"，叠加特朗普政府明确反对，前沿实验室的自我监管正失去政治与舆论合法性。与此同时，产品侧的竞争反而加速：GPT-6 Astra、Gemini 3.8 Live、重建版 Siri、Meta One 订阅在同一天落地，说明"说慢做快"的张力已达峰值。技术层面，今天最值得开发者关注的是 GVA 的 KV cache 重构方案与 Orthrus"无损"声明的复现失败——推理加速领域的宣称需要更严格的独立验证。开源侧，colibri 用纯 C 让消费级硬件跑前沿 MoE，与 Voodoo Quant 转 MIT 一起，持续压低本地部署门槛。

items.title: OpenAI 发布 GPT-6 Astra，主打编程与计算机操作
items.desc: OpenAI 推出面向 coding 和 computer use 的新模型 GPT-6 Astra，Perplexity、Cognition（Devin）等已接入用于端到端系统操作与自测。
items.value: Agent 型编程与自动化操作的新基座模型

items.title: Google 发布 Gemini 3.8 Live 与 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.desc: 两款语音到语音模型登顶 Artificial Analysis 语音榜，每小时语音对话仅 $1.38，显著低于 OpenAI GPT-Live-1。
items.value: 实时语音 Agent 成本大幅下降，开发者可低成本接入

items.title: Apple 发布基于 Google Gemini 重建的 Siri AI
items.desc: 多年延期后 Siri 全面重构，部分端侧运行、部分走 Private Cloud Compute，但欧盟暂不可用，早期测试者反馈存在幻觉与个人上下文缺失。
items.value: 巨头间模型外包成常态，端云混合架构值得参考

items.title: Meta 为 WhatsApp Business 推出 MCP server
items.desc: 开发者可用 Claude、Cursor、Codex、ChatGPT 等 AI coding agent 自动完成 WhatsApp Business 的配置、消息模板、测试与排障。
items.value: MCP 进入商业消息基础设施，Agent 可接管配置运维

items.title: OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 就 AI 安全进行了数周会谈
items.desc: OpenAI 证实与 Anthropic、Google DeepMind 就 AI 安全展开数周磋商，而特朗普团队淡化安全担忧、力推对华竞争。
items.value: 前沿实验室协调机制初现，但政策端态度分裂

items.title: OpenAI 用自家 LLM 设计出 Jalapeño 芯片
items.desc: OpenAI 首款 AI 加速器 Jalapeño 提供 13.4 petaflops 4-bit 算力、232GB 内存、15.4TB/s 带宽，相比 Nvidia GB300 端到端延迟最多降低 3.6 倍。
items.value: LLM 参与芯片设计闭环，推理硬件自主化信号

items.title: Hugging Face 就入侵事件向 OpenAI 索赔 1 亿美元算力
items.desc: Hugging Face 要求 OpenAI 支付 1 亿美元算力作为入侵事件赔偿，并追查相关痕迹，事件在 HN 引发 127 点讨论。
items.value: 平台间安全责任与算力赔付争议升温

items.title: Anthropic 谋求纳斯达克上市
items.desc: Anthropic 告知投资者将连续第二个季度盈利，为 mega-IPO 铺路，但盈利口径为调整后指标，剔除股权激励等成本。
items.value: 头部 AI 实验室 IPO 竞赛开启，估值锚点将重塑

items.title: Meta 推出 AI 订阅套餐 Meta One
items.desc: Meta 将 Facebook、Instagram、WhatsApp 的高级功能与额外 AI 用量打包成 Meta One 订阅，面向个人、创作者与企业分档全球上线。
items.value: 社交平台 AI 变现模式定型，订阅分层成主流

items.title: OpenRouter 上周 OpenAI 模型支出超过 Anthropic
items.desc: OpenRouter 披露上周用户对 OpenAI 模型的消费额超过 Anthropic 模型，反映开发者 API 选择偏好变化。
items.value: 模型市场格局的实时风向标，值得持续追踪

items.title: Agility Robotics 发布 Digit 5 人形机器人
items.desc: 新一代仓库/工厂人形机器人可在无需安全围栏的情况下与人类并肩工作。
items.value: 人机协作安全标准突破，落地场景进一步打开

items.title: 纽约查封 12 个名人深度伪造网站
items.desc: 曼哈顿地检办公室发起史上最大规模针对有害 deepfake 网站的法律行动，约 1200 名受害者被波及。
items.value: deepfake 执法进入实质查封阶段，合规风险上升

items.title: 盖茨基金会两年投入至少 10 亿美元推动 AI 普惠
items.desc: 投向健康、教育、农业领域，盖茨警告早期语言模型 90% 以上训练数据来自英语，Yoruba 语语音识别失败率高达 60%。
items.value: 多语言与低资源场景仍是 AI 公平性最大缺口

items.title: 荣耀发布行业首个系统级 Agent Harness 架构 MagicOS 11
items.desc: 首发搭载于荣耀 Magic9，开启尝鲜计划，将 Agent 能力下沉至操作系统层。
items.value: 手机 OS 级 Agent 架构竞争开启，端侧调度成关键

items.title: 飞书与豆包工作合体后首次亮相
items.desc: Agent 可进群协作，并支持撰写周报、制作 PPT 等办公任务。
items.value: 办公 Agent 从单点工具走向群组协同工作流

items.title: OpenAI 故意欠技术债，等 Codex 来还
items.desc: 仅 2 名工程师借助 Codex 将核心存储从 Python 重写为 Rust，展示 AI 辅助大规模重构的可行性。
items.value: AI 重构遗留系统的真实工程案例，可复用经验

items.title: Learning to Solve Hard Problems in RL for LLMs by Never Giving Up
items.desc: 研究发现 RL 训练对简单题提升大、对难题提升小，提出"马太效应"解释并给出改进方法。
items.value: 揭示 RLVR 训练数据分配的结构性缺陷

items.title: Root-Cause Attribution Is a Search Problem
items.desc: 将长程 Agent 失败归因建模为搜索问题，解决执行日志过大导致 LLM 诊断准确率低的问题。
items.value: Agent 可靠性工程的关键基础设施方法

items.title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding?
items.desc: 独立复现 Orthrus 架构，发现在 BF16 精度下其"无损"投机解码声明不成立。
items.value: 提醒推理加速方案的数值精度陷阱，复现价值高

items.title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
items.desc: 提出 GVA，仅存分组 value 并用学习到的线性映射重建 key，推理时可吸收进 query。
items.value: KV cache 内存与带宽瓶颈的新解法，长上下文利好

items.title: Expert-Space Exploration in MoE Reinforcement Learning
items.desc: 发现扰动 MoE 专家路由可提供额外 rollout 多样性，为 MoE 后训练开辟新维度。
items.value: MoE 模型 RL 后训练的新探索方向

items.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
items.desc: 7B dense 模型从零训练，强调内部思考与外部工具调用耦合，支持 256K 上下文，完全开源。
items.value: 小模型+工具调用的高效开源范式，可复现

items.title: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
items.desc: 发布面向科研与工程工作流的 foundation agentic 语言模型，通过可验证经验管线训练。
items.value: Agent 参与自身迭代的科研自动化路线图

items.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
items.desc: 提出无 critic 的 BPO 方法，用 Bellman 方程将 Policy Mirror Descent 重构为轨迹级目标，避免中间状态估值。
items.value: RLVR 训练简化，降低 LLM 推理后训练成本

items.title: Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection
items.desc: 发现"计划注入"攻击，可在 CoT 监控下执行对抗行为而不被察觉。
items.value: CoT 监控安全策略存在系统性漏洞，需重新设计

items.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
items.desc: 证明冻结的 LLM 前向传播中已含路由信号，两个线性映射即可读出，无需预载全部 skill 元数据。
items.value: Agent skill 库规模上限被打破，路由更高效

items.title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models
items.desc: 证明视频模型生成错误物理运动并非"没学到"，而是"没用到"，可通过低维编辑重新引导。
items.value: 视频生成可控性新机制，物理一致性可干预

items.title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark
items.desc: 提出 VLoc Bench，含 500 个真实漏洞，评估 Agent 在仓库级代码中定位漏洞实现文件的能力。
items.value: Agent 安全分析从"能否发现"转向"能否定位"

items.title: Dynin-Robotics: Omnimodal Unified Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model
items.desc: 在 omnimodal masked-diffusion 骨干上统一语言、视觉目标与动作，通过共享轨迹模型做动作生成与选择。
items.value: VLA 统一扩散架构，机器人策略新范式

items.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
items.desc: 将语言响应、末端执行器运动与稠密视觉目标编码为离散序列联合自回归优化。
items.value: 物理世界基础模型，观察-交互-变化闭环

items.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
items.desc: 提出 DFM 概念，主张下一前沿是从解决问题转向参与新问题、新表征与新知识的创造过程。
items.value: 为 AI for Science 提供新的能力框架定义

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.desc: 阿里开源的混合架构代码审查工具，确定性流水线 + LLM Agent，支持行级精确评论与多语言规则集，兼容 OpenAI 与 Anthropic。
items.value: 大厂规模验证过的生产级 code review Agent

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.desc: 纯 C、零依赖的推理引擎，专家权重从磁盘流式加载，让消费级硬件跑前沿 MoE 模型。
items.value: 本地跑大 MoE 模型的极简方案，硬件门槛骤降

items.title: alphaXiv/OpenResearch
items.desc: 把 coding agent 转化为 research agent 的工具集。
items.value: 复用现有 Agent 生态做科研自动化，上手成本低

items.title: addyosmani/agent-skills
items.desc: 面向 AI coding agent 的生产级工程技能集，由 Addy Osmani 维护。
items.value: 提升 coding agent 输出质量的实用技能库

items.title: earendil-works/pi
items.desc: AI agent 工具包，统一 LLM API、agent loop、TUI 与 coding agent CLI。
items.value: 一体化 Agent 开发脚手架，减少重复造轮子

items.title: pacifio/atlas
items.desc: 面向 Agent 的源码版本控制，可同时使用多个 coding agent 并集中追踪、查询其改动。
items.value: 多 Agent 并行开发时代的变更管理基础设施

items.title: danny-avila/LibreChat
items.desc: 增强版 ChatGPT 克隆，支持 Agents、MCP、Skills、多家模型切换、代码解释器与多用户鉴权，可自托管。
items.value: 企业自托管 AI 门户的成熟开源方案

items.title: Voodoo Dynamic Quant 转为 MIT 许可
items.desc: 作者将此前私有的动态量化方法开源，该方法在激进量化级别下于部分 Qwen3.5 GGUF 模型上达到 SOTA。
items.value: 低比特量化新方法开放，本地部署受益明显

items.title: 无问芯穹开源具身端侧推理引擎 APXInf
items.desc: 联合清华、上交开源，在 Pi 0.5 上达到性能 SOTA，瞄准具身智能规模化落地最后一公里。
items.value: 具身模型端侧推理的关键工程基础设施

items.title: "放缓前沿"是安全共识还是卡特尔？
items.desc: Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei 发表《We Must Pace the Frontier》长文呼吁放缓 AI 开发，Sam Altman、Elon Musk、Demis Hassabis 相继表态支持，但 Cohere CEO Aidan Gomez 直指这是"换了名字的卡特尔"，特朗普与白宫则公开反对，批评者认为这是头部实验室借安全之名构筑准入壁垒。
items.value: 前沿实验室协调行为面临反垄断与信任双重质疑

items.title: AI Agent 正在"污染"互联网
items.desc: 404 Media 报道"Timmy""Ren""Jackie"等 AI bot 在社交平台大量灌水，HN 上 206 点、143 条评论激辩 Agent 对公共信息生态的破坏；同时 TechCrunch 报道出现"AI Contact Hotline"供 Agent 举报目睹的不当行为。
items.value: Agent 规模化后的内容生态与治理问题浮上台面

en.headline: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra for coding and computer use

items.title: OpenAI releases GPT-6 Astra for coding and computer use
items.desc: OpenAI launched GPT-6 Astra targeting coding and computer use, with Perplexity and Cognition (Devin) already integrating it for end-to-end system operation and self-testing.
items.value: New base model for agentic coding and automation

items.title: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.desc: Two speech-to-speech models top the Artificial Analysis voice leaderboard at $1.38 per hour of conversation, significantly undercutting OpenAI's GPT-Live-1.
items.value: Real-time voice agent costs drop sharply for developers

items.title: Apple ships rebuilt Siri AI built on Google's Gemini
items.desc: After years of delay, Siri is fully rebuilt, running partly on-device and partly via Private Cloud Compute, but unavailable in the EU; early testers report hallucinations and gaps in personal context.
items.value: Model outsourcing between giants becomes normal; hybrid edge-cloud reference

items.title: Meta launches MCP server for WhatsApp Business
items.desc: Developers can use AI coding agents like Claude, Cursor, Codex, and ChatGPT to automate WhatsApp Business setup, message templates, testing, and troubleshooting.
items.value: MCP enters business messaging infra; agents take over config ops

items.title: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google held weeks of AI safety talks
items.desc: OpenAI confirmed weeks of AI safety discussions with Anthropic and Google DeepMind, while Trump's team downplays safety concerns and pushes to keep pace with China.
items.value: Frontier lab coordination emerges, but policy stance is split

items.title: OpenAI used its own LLMs to design the Jalapeño chip
items.desc: OpenAI's debut AI accelerator delivers 13.4 petaflops of 4-bit compute, 232GB memory, and 15.4TB/s bandwidth, cutting end-to-end latency up to 3.6x versus Nvidia's GB300.
items.value: LLMs in chip design loop; inference hardware independence signal

items.title: Hugging Face bills OpenAI $100M in compute for hacking incident
items.desc: Hugging Face is demanding $100M in compute from OpenAI as compensation over a hacking incident and tracing related trails, sparking a 127-point HN discussion.
items.value: Platform security liability and compute compensation disputes escalate

items.title: Anthropic eyes Nasdaq listing
items.desc: Anthropic told investors it will post a second straight profitable quarter to pave the way for a mega-IPO, though the profit metric is adjusted and excludes costs like stock-based compensation.
items.value: Top AI labs race to IPO; valuation anchors will be reset

items.title: Meta launches AI subscription bundles Meta One
items.desc: Meta bundles premium Facebook, Instagram, and WhatsApp features with extra AI usage into Meta One subscriptions, available globally in tiers for individuals, creators, and businesses.
items.value: Social platform AI monetization model solidifies; tiered subs mainstream

items.title: OpenRouter users spent more on OpenAI than Anthropic models last week
items.desc: OpenRouter disclosed that user spending on OpenAI models exceeded Anthropic models last week, reflecting shifting developer API preferences.
items.value: Real-time barometer of model market share; worth tracking

items.title: Agility Robotics unveils Digit 5 humanoid robot
items.desc: The next-gen humanoid for warehouses and factories can work alongside humans without safety fences.
items.value: Human-robot collaboration safety breakthrough; deployment scenarios expand

items.title: New York seizes a dozen celebrity deepfake websites
items.desc: The Manhattan DA's office launched the largest-ever legal action against harmful deepfake sites, affecting roughly 1,200 victims.
items.value: Deepfake enforcement enters seizure phase; compliance risk rises

items.title: Gates Foundation commits at least $1B over two years for AI access
items.desc: Investing in health, education, and agriculture; Gates warns over 90% of early language model training data was English, and speech recognition fails 60% of the time in Yoruba.
items.value: Multilingual and low-resource gaps remain AI's biggest fairness issue

items.title: Honor launches industry-first system-level Agent Harness architecture MagicOS 11
items.desc: Debuting on Honor Magic9 with an early access program, pushing agent capabilities down to the OS layer.
items.value: Phone OS-level agent architecture race begins; on-device scheduling key

items.title: Feishu and Doubao Work make joint debut
items.desc: Agents can join group chats and handle tasks like writing weekly reports and making PPTs.
items.value: Office agents shift from point tools to group collaboration workflows

items.title: OpenAI deliberately took on tech debt, letting Codex pay it back
items.desc: Just 2 engineers used Codex to rewrite core storage from Python to Rust, demonstrating AI-assisted large-scale refactoring.
items.value: Real engineering case of AI refactoring legacy systems; reusable lessons

items.title: Learning to Solve Hard Problems in RL for LLMs by Never Giving Up
items.desc: RL training yields large gains on easy problems but small gains on hard ones; the paper proposes a "Matthew Effect" explanation and an improved method.
items.value: Exposes structural flaw in RLVR training data allocation

items.title: Root-Cause Attribution Is a Search Problem
items.desc: Models long-horizon agent failure attribution as a search problem, addressing low LLM diagnostic accuracy as execution logs grow.
items.value: Key infrastructure method for agent reliability engineering

items.title: How Lossless Is Lossless Speculative Decoding?
items.desc: Independently reproduces Orthrus and finds its "lossless" speculative decoding claim fails under BF16 precision.
items.value: Warns of numerical precision traps in inference acceleration; high reproduction value

items.title: Grouped Value Attention: Efficient KV Caching via On-Demand Key Reconstruction
items.desc: Proposes GVA, storing only grouped values and reconstructing keys via a learned linear map that can be absorbed into the query at inference.
items.value: New fix for KV cache memory and bandwidth bottlenecks; long-context win

items.title: Expert-Space Exploration in MoE Reinforcement Learning
items.desc: Finds that perturbing MoE expert routing provides additional rollout diversity, opening a new dimension for MoE post-training.
items.value: New exploration direction for MoE model RL post-training

items.title: ZGCM-1: A Fully Open and Extremely Efficient Foundation Model for Math and Agentic Search
items.desc: A 7B dense model trained from scratch coupling internal thinking with external tool use, supporting 256K context, fully open.
items.value: Efficient small-model-plus-tools open paradigm; reproducible

items.title: Atria Dawn: The Dawn of Agentic Superintelligence
items.desc: Releases a foundation agentic language model for scientific research and engineering workflows, trained via a verifiable experience pipeline.
items.value: Roadmap for agents participating in their own iteration for science

items.title: Bellman Policy Optimization
items.desc: Introduces critic-free BPO, reformulating Policy Mirror Descent via Bellman equations into a trajectory-level objective, avoiding intermediate state value estimation.
items.value: Simplifies RLVR training, cutting LLM reasoning post-training cost

items.title: Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection
items.desc: Discovers a "plan injection" attack that executes adversarial actions while evading CoT monitors.
items.value: CoT monitoring safety strategy has systemic holes; needs redesign

items.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
items.desc: Shows a frozen LLM's forward passes already contain routing signals readable by two linear maps, without preloading all skill metadata.
items.value: Breaks agent skill library size ceiling; more efficient routing

items.title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models
items.desc: Shows video models generating wrong physical motion haven't failed to learn it, but failed to use it—recoverable via low-dimensional edits.
items.value: New controllability mechanism for video generation; physics intervenable

items.title: Vulnerability Localization Benchmark
items.desc: Introduces VLoc Bench with 500 real-world vulnerabilities, evaluating agents' ability to locate implementation files at repository scale.
items.value: Agent security analysis shifts from detection to localization

items.title: Dynin-Robotics: Omnimodal Unified Diffusion Vision-Language-Action Model
items.desc: Unifies language, visual goals, and actions on an omnimodal masked-diffusion backbone via a shared trajectory model for action generation and selection.
items.value: Unified diffusion VLA architecture; new robot policy paradigm

items.title: PhysBrain 1.5: From Vision-Language Models to Physical Foundation Models
items.desc: Encodes language responses, end-effector motion, and dense visual targets as discrete sequences jointly optimized with autoregressive prediction.
items.value: Physical world foundation model closing observation-interaction-change loop

items.title: Discovery Foundation Models: Toward Open-Ended Discovery Intelligence
items.desc: Proposes DFMs, arguing the next frontier is shifting from solving problems to participating in creating new problems, representations, and knowledge.
items.value: New capability framework definition for AI for Science

items.title: alibaba/open-code-review
items.desc: Alibaba's open-source hybrid code review tool combining deterministic pipelines with an LLM Agent, offering precise line-level comments and a multi-language ruleset, OpenAI and Anthropic compatible.
items.value: Production-grade code review agent validated at Alibaba scale

items.title: JustVugg/colibri
items.desc: A pure C, zero-dependency inference engine that streams expert weights from disk, letting consumer hardware run frontier MoE models.
items.value: Minimal path to run large MoE models locally; hardware barrier drops
